citation.title: Generative Lattice Units with 3D Diffusion for Inverse Design: GLU3D
citation.authors: Yayati Jadhav; Joeseph Berthel; Chunshan Hu; Rahul P. Panat; Jack Beuth; Amir Barati Farimani
citation.version_coded: abstract only (reconstructed from OpenAlex, https://api.openalex.org/works/W4399444986); no legal full-text route could be reached

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract states that a denoising-diffusion model (GLU3D) generates manufacturable lattice unit cells with desired isotropic/anisotropic stiffness, and that these outperform 'traditional unit cells like simple cubic and body-centered-cubic' in energy absorption and compression load at lower densities.
claim.key_phrase: outperforming traditional unit cells like simple cubic and body-centered-cubic in energy absorption and compression load
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not derivable: the abstract's comparison is a design-performance claim (energy absorption, compression load at lower density) with no number given, and no classical optimization method's time or cost is mentioned; the abstract separately says the framework 'accelerates design process' but gives no baseline time or ratio.
claim.alternatives: None identifiable from the abstract alone.
